improvements: Longer tapered irregularly spaced shore streaks reduce the dashed-road effect.
Dark carrier structures in some images recover earlier depth; identical retained visuals receive prior scores.
visible_regressions: No new major regression in softened foam; it remains sparse brushlike strokes.
Pale-outline carrier controls show flatter structural depth than dark-edge versions.
top3_gaps: Foam needs irregular overlapping breakup and wash at shore, not isolated thin strokes.
Surface response remains simplified: coarse grass, smooth sand, clothlike repeated ocean texture and schematic decks.
Player ring gives location but cannot restore hidden aircraft silhouette; smoke grain and scalloped wake repetition remain.
_summary.blinding_limitations: All45 images viewed individually. Only own prior reports consulted. No key/source/other judges inspected. Known repeated scene families limit identity blinding. Packet mean includes many older low-scoring controls and is not an iteration comparison.
